mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change below 2.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 95.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% indicates a slowing economy, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase above 130,000 thousand persons indicates a robust labor market, driving consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 130,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.
